wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a completely blank grid - all ~40 ruled data rows empty - and, unlike the expenditure sheet, its printed TOTAL cell is left ENTIRELY BLANK (verified in a 600 dpi crop: the cell holds only the pre-printed '$' and its rule, with no zero glyph and no dash). So schedule_total is '' (the field exists, the filer left it empty), NOT a zero, and the cover is the only anchor. Cover line 1 carries a handwritten 0 in all three columns and cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) likewise, so there is no small-donor aggregate. Rows sum 0.00 = the cover cells; LAST is 0 so the two scopes coincide, recorded as cumulative.

expenditures.detail: One row, 571.00, equal to Form B's printed TOTAL 571.00 and to both filled cover line-3 cells (THIS 571.00, CUMULATIVE 571.00; LAST is 0). This is the filer's first report of the 2020 cycle - the certified period begins 3/17/2020, the same date as the single expenditure - so the period and cumulative scopes coincide and are recorded as cumulative. The decimal separator in the CUMULATIVE cover cell and in the schedule TOTAL is written as a comma-like tick rather than a clean point, but the value is unambiguous at 571 dollars and 00 cents in all three printings.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: 0 rows against a BLANK printed TOTAL cell - nothing to sum and nothing printed to sum against; the cover's 0 is the anchor. p3: one row 571.00 = printed TOTAL 571.00 (gate fires).
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 -> geometry_status 'gaps', 34 h-rules at a ~1.69pct pitch (the sheet is visibly skewed, which is why the tool loses rules; treated as evidence, not an oracle). Ink counted by eye on the full 200 dpi page: p3 has exactly ONE inked row, the topmost data row, and the 900 dpi amount-column crop shows the three bands below it empty. p2 has zero inked rows across the whole grid. 1 row emitted, 0 rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p3: the 900 dpi crop of the amount column at the emitted band renders '$ 571.00' and the three control bands one, two and three pitches below each render an empty cell carrying only the printed '$'. Because the page carries a visible skew, the row band was measured directly in the amount column's own x-range rather than taken from the full-width rule fit.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, and the discrepancy is the filer's. Contributions 0 - expenditures 571.00 = -571.00, but cover line 4 (balance at the end of the reporting period) is written as a POSITIVE 571.00 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells (LAST is 0), with no minus sign anywhere - confirmed in a 600 dpi crop of cover lines 3 and 4, which shows the two lines carrying identical figures. Nothing was recomputed or overwritten; the stated figures are retained verbatim. Worth noting alongside chunk-mate dc15a362 (Tom Durrant, 2020, same office cycle, same form): that filer wrote the arithmetically correct -571.00 for the same $571 filing fee, so the sign convention on this line is not consistent across filers. No earlier filing by this filer in this cycle is in my chunk, so the cross-filing chain could not be run; the cover declares the period as beginning 3/17/2020 and its LAST column is 0 throughout, which is consistent with a first report.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crop of cover lines 3 and 4 (to test for a minus sign on the balance line - there is none); 600 dpi crop of the p2 TOTAL cell (blank, not a zero glyph); 900 dpi crops of the p3 row-1 date/vendor/purpose cells and of the p3 amount column with three control bands. One wasted crop at the wrong y offset was re-taken.
notes: Generation-2 county-branded cover (Washington County Code 1-7-1) with the four-line anchor grid and an In Kind? column on Form A. Chunk file says candidate 'Robert Foster', office 'Recorder'; the cover's handwritten name line reads 'Robert Foster' and the Office line reads 'Recorder' (written in red ink) - both AGREE. The filer also wrote 'Representative District: 2nd Congressional' and 'In the Washington County School District' on two lines that do not apply to a county row office; these are stray entries on inapplicable fields, not an office contradiction - the Office line governs and it says Recorder, a county office, so the filing is in scope. Certified period March 17, 2020 to June 18, 2020; signature date written '6-18-20'; clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 18 2020. Candidate home street address, ZIP and home phone printed in the clear on the cover were discarded at read time.

expenditures.note: date written '3-17-20' in a cramped hand; the two-digit year resolves to 2020 and the date equals the certified period's own start date (March 17, 2020), which corroborates it. Amount written '571.00' with the cents formed as a joined double-o; confirmed at 900 dpi and by the printed TOTAL 571.00.
